Discovered project uses dead tree-sitter-markdown 0.7.1 (archived 2021) while active crate is tree-sitter-md 0.5.2 (tree-sitter-grammars org, Jan 2026). Created epic marky-6gw for full migration to tree-sitter 0.26 + tree-sitter-md MarkdownParser wrapper with 5 subtasks.
